_doc: Model and effort per workload. router: the session running modernize-auto (interactively it is your session's model; headless pass --model). agents: each stage agent; the router passes `model` on every Agent call, `effort` comes from the agent file's frontmatter and must match (a test checks).

router.why: setup, dispatch, run the gate, decide; no heavy reading

stage-analyze.why: read the source once: ETL list, mapping, inventories, rules, RUN.json

stage-audit.why: independent referee of the analysis against the source

stage-transform.why: one-to-one Java that must reproduce the legacy exactly

stage-verify.why: independent re-check: tests, canary, fresh inputs, proof pack

stage-fix.why: trace differences to the legacy source and fix root causes
